deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy: routing policy 'realtime' -> apply soft_limit=120, request_timeout=2200ms, rate_sculpt=0.85. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary -> 5% for 15m.
maria gonzalez: on it. I'll run preflight against canary tenants list and watch kvcache and tail latencies.
raj patel: FYI watch for 95th pct spike — last time soft_limit bumped we saw a small tail from long-context LLMs.
samir: can we avoid full version pin? this is config-only, just routing rule + batching hint. no model change.
maria gonzalez: correct, no model version change. We'll pin routing rule to variant stable-2026-03 for fallback.
lee: suggest adding a temporary circuit_breaker threshold at 12% error increase for auto-rollback.
maria gonzalez: added in staging, snippet below: 
```
route: realtime
soft_limit: 120
request_timeout_ms: 2200
rate_sculpt: 0.85
auto_rollback: {error_pct_delta: 12, monitoring_window_mins: 10}
```
raj patel: looks good. Also add a note to release notes: "Config-only: routing soft_limit/timeouts/shape tweak to reduce cold-run latency"
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% at 1698765600. Health: OK, 1min p50=180ms, p95=580ms, errors=0.2%.
ops-bot: Observability alert created: /ops/alerts/realtime-softlimit-1698765432 (watch p95, kvcache misses).
samir: rolling to 25% in 10m unless we see error surge.
maria gonzalez: preflight passed for canary tenants. No kvcache pressure. proceeding.
deploy-bot: Progressing to 25% at 1698765960. Health: p95=610ms, errors=0.3%, slight increase in tail but below rollback threshold.
lee: keeping eyes on long-tail generator tenant. If errors > 12% relative to baseline, we auto-rollback.
raj patel: adding manual watch: I'll be on-call for next 40m. ping me if anything odd.
maria gonzalez: scheduled release notes update and quick rollback playbook in #release-war-room.
deploy-bot: Global rollout complete at 1698766507. Final health: p95=590ms, errors=0.25%. No rollback triggered.
samir: nice, thanks team. Filing a follow-up to tune rate_sculpt by tenant cohort next week. :thumbsup:
maria gonzalez: will schedule a quick retro with metrics.
